labels.assessment: Surplus/excess/remainder, including mathematical remainder, are not a sovereign order. Complete adverb, degree and negative-construction senses do not introduce an imperial-order sense. This judgment considers meanings, not merely a noun/adverb contrast.
labels.restrictions: 剰え is rare, 剰 is search-only in1580500; its adverb is dated, usually kana and usually negative in nuance. 剰り is search-only in1584930; remainder/suffix senses are restricted toあまり, notあんまり. 余る is an actual separate spelling, not proof of a modern剰る example.
labels.existingGuard: Preserve the evidenced direct 剰/冗 semantic protection and its nontransitivity. No title distortion, removal of ordinary secondary senses or new 勅/剰 guard is justified by these samples.

labels.assessment: Handling/treatment, managing problems, operating machinery, selling goods, covering topics and treating A as B concern engagement with something, not issuing or constituting an imperial order. The complete archaic mediation/unmanageable/gossip senses and stripping/threshing senses do not establish equivalence either. An order may direct handling something; that thematic relation alone does not make the displayed answer correct for勅.
labels.restrictions: Distinguish扱くこく2029490 from扱くしごく1153460. The latter preservesしごく-only restrictions in the first two senses and the separate usually-kana sexual sense, usuallyシゴく, without applying that sense indiscriminately toこく. Neither family verifies metadataあつか.る. Full source-only on readings remain reference, not new quiz keys.

labels.assessment: Beast/brute/animal, veterinary profession, fierce animal and animal trail do not denote a sovereign order. Even the abusive-person usage discussed in the inherited articles does not make the animal label a command; no fixed animal-versus-person division betweenけもの andけだもの is assumed.
labels.restrictions: 1335590 preservesけもの/けだもの/じゅう and kana-only variants; its subculture animal-with-human-characteristics sense is restricted toケモノ. It is not assigned to every spelling/reading. Existing Daijisen usage claims are context inherited from accepted cards, not freshly independently retrieved or recertified here.

labels.assessment: The spear/lance/pike sense, broader weapons/arms, bow grip and decorated parade-float abbreviation do not denote an imperial order. Orders may concern weapons or a procession, but that relationship does not turn the actual weapon label into an order. The separate contradiction/inconsistency family likewise supplies no command sense.
labels.restrictions: All seven spellings in1603450 are preserved. とかり is restricted to鋒, not a reading for矛. Weapon/arms and bow-grip senses are restricted toほこ. The float sense is an abbreviation, not equivalence between every float and spear. 矛楯 is the rare spelling in1531090.

labels.assessment: The broad food meaning, specific potato/taro/sweet-potato and botanical calla senses are not an imperial order. The full derogatory yokel/bumpkin and dismissive dud/worthless-thing senses also do not establish interchangeability. The judgment does not rely on treating芋as one species or a strict botanical category.
labels.restrictions: Preserve rare薯/藷 spellings, kana-onlyイモ, search-only potato spellings, kana preferences on the relevant plant families, andかんしょ restricted to甘薯/甘藷 rather than薩摩芋. 海芋かいう is the botanical on example, not a substitute pronunciation for foodいも.
